description_en: Returns SQL template statistics from query governance data
description_zh: 调用GetQueryOptimizeDataStats接口，获取查询治理模板数据
name: GetQueryOptimizeDataStats

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

MySQL

PolarDBMySQL

PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

MySQL
PolarDBMySQL
PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，多个实例ID用逗号分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The keywords of the SQL template. Separate multiple keywords with spaces
parameters.help_zh: SQL文本关键词，多个关键词以空格分隔
parameters.name: keywords

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship between multiple keywords. Valid values:

or

and
parameters.help_zh:
多个SQL文本关键词的逻辑关系。

or：或。
and：与
parameters.name: logical_operator

parameters.help_en: The tags that are used to filter SQL templates. Separate multiple tags with commas (,). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/290038.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要过滤的规则，多个规则以逗号分隔。具体信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/290038.html
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en: The name of the database to be queried
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en: The time range to query. Specify the time in the UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据的日期，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询每页最大记录数，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的页码，从1开始，默认为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the returned entries. Default value: count. Valid values:

count: the number of executions.

maxQueryTime: the longest execution time.

avgQueryTime: the average execution time.

maxLockTime: the longest lock wait time.

avgLockTime: the longest lock wait time.

maxRowsExamined: the largest number of scanned rows.

avgRowsExamined: the average number of scanned rows.

maxRowsSent: the largest number of returned rows.

avgRowsSent: the average number of returned rows
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认为count。

count：执行次数。
maxQueryTime：最大执行时间。
avgQueryTime：平均执行时间。
maxLockTime：最大锁等待时间。
avgLockTime：平均锁等待时间。
maxRowsExamined：最大扫描行数。
avgRowsExamined：平均扫描行数。
maxRowsSent：最大返回行数。
avgRowsSent：平均返回行数
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort the returned entries in ascending order. Default value: true. Valid values:

true: sorts the returned entries in ascending order.

false: does not sort the returned entries in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
是否升序排序，默认为true。

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only SQL templates that need to be optimized. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: queries only SQL templates that need to be optimized.

false: does not query only SQL statements that need to be optimized
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询待优化的SQL，默认为false。

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: only_optimized_sql

parameters.help_en: The SQL template ID. You can query the ID of a template by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/405235.html operation
parameters.help_zh: SQL模板ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/405235.html接口查询SQL模板ID
parameters.name: sql_ids

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the instance resides. Valid values:

cn-china: Chinese mainland

cn-hongkong: China (Hong Kong)

ap-southeast-1: Singapore

This parameter takes effect only if InstanceIds is left empty. If you leave InstanceIds empty, the system obtains data from the region set by Region. By default, Region is set to cn-china. If you specify InstanceIds, Region does not take effect and the system obtains data from the region in which the first specified instance resides.\\

Set this parameter to cn-china for the instances that are created in the regions in the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属地域，取值：

cn-china：中国内地。
cn-hongkong：中国香港。
ap-southeast-1：新加坡。

此参数只有在请求参数InstanceIds为空时有效。如果请求参数InstanceIds为空时，按照Region参数设置的地域获取数据，系统默认实例所属地域为cn-china；如果请求参数InstanceIds不为空时，即使设置了Region参数，也以InstanceIds所传入的第一个实例所在地域为准获取数据。

在中国内地各地域创建的实例，传入此参数时，都为cn-china
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The account of the database to be queried
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的数据库账号
parameters.name: user

List.description_en: The information about the SQL templates

AvgLockTime.description_en: The average lock wait time. Unit: seconds
AvgLockTime.description_zh: 平均锁等待时间，单位为秒

AvgQueryTime.description_en: The average query execution time. Unit: seconds
AvgQueryTime.description_zh: 平均查询时间，单位为秒

AvgRowsAffected.description_en:
The average number of rows affected by the SQL statement.

A value of -1 indicates that this parameter is not collected
AvgRowsAffected.description_zh:
平均影响行数。

取值为-1说明暂未采集到该字段

AvgRowsExamined.description_en: The average number of scanned rows

AvgRowsSent.description_en: The average number of returned rows

Count.description_en: The number of times that the SQL template is executed

Dbname.description_en: The name of the database to which the SQL template belongs

MaxLockTime.description_en: The longest lock wait time. Unit: seconds
MaxLockTime.description_zh: 最大锁等待时间，单位为秒

MaxQueryTime.description_en: The longest query execution time. Unit: seconds
MaxQueryTime.description_zh: 最大查询时间，单位为秒

MaxRowsAffected.description_en:
The largest number of rows affected by the SQL template.

A value of -1 indicates that this parameter is not collected
MaxRowsAffected.description_zh:
最大影响行数。

取值为-1说明暂未采集到该字段

MaxRowsExamined.description_en: The largest number of scanned rows

MaxRowsSent.description_en: The largest number of returned rows

Name.description_zh: 规则名，具体信息请参见[查询治理]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/290038.html）

Type.description_en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

Predefined

UserDefined
Type.description_zh:
规则类别：

Predefined：系统预定义。
UserDefined：用户自定义

SqlSample.description_en: The sample query that took the longest time to execute
SqlSample.description_zh: SQL模板下执行最慢的SQL样本

SqlType.description_en: The type of the SQL statement

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
